_readme: MORE MUSIC (SOUNDS 10/24/26, row [more music, on the one beat], rule 158(d); Paolo 10/24: 'a big thing is we need more music'). One row in the shape of his MLOOPS rows, his REPO MAN's own row with 2 fields changed, each taken from one of his canon songs (provenance), played by his own engine with REPO MAN THE MACHINE PARTY's machine playing along (engine/bohemia_machine_party.js, the kit in slices/vote/songs/machine_party_kit/). Made by tools/bohemia_sounds_more_music.js; gate gates/more_music_gate.js. Never in MLOOPS on disk, never in the fence or CAT_DEFAULTS, until his YES (rule 122(d)).
name: THE METER READER
story: the man who still comes round to read the meter on houses that have had no power for a year

inst.l: the pawnshop's piano with keys that stick and die: REPO MAN's cold piano, after somebody pawned it
am: the dread bed his PIT BOSS hums under beat one, in place of the dead satellite
acc: its colour in the MUSIC tab, the lead's song's

analog_horror_at_the_source: the tune is his engine's, drawn from the name, on brokenkeys (PAWNSHOP PSALM)
under every bar powergrid, and on beat one of the core dreadbed: the rooms the song is set in, from his own voices
the beat arrives late (no drums for the first eight bars on the map, his 9/12 rule) and his strip sections leave only the kick and the bass

the machine is REPO MAN THE MACHINE PARTY's, real recordings of real machines (a train coupling, an electromechanical clock, steel, a washing machine's motor in the song's key), in one concrete hall on a worn tape: the wear is in what plays, no noise is added (NO SAND)

press.on: his kick (drumV with the row's kit.k)
press.is: a coupling slamming between two train wagons

relay.on: his hat (drumV with the row's kit.h)

party.is: the press on beats two and four in his D sections: four to the bar

clank.is: steel on steel on the and of two, every other bar

motor.is: a washing machine's motor whining in this song's key (+0 semitones from REPO MAN's G3), changing speed with his key moves; louder in his C sections, where the song strips to kick and bass

hall.is: one concrete hall, 10 x 18 x 7 m, the machine wetter than the music

tape.is: the from-a-recording tool's tape: a head bump, a soft tanh, wow and flutter, a gentle 2:1, a 9 kHz top

machine.from: slices/vote/songs/repo_man_the_machine_party.json (his YES 10/19, sounds-repo-man-the-machine-party-10-19), every number but the motor's key

card.title: A NEW NIGHT SONG: THE METER READER
card.why: You said we need more music. This is a new night song made in your songs' own machine: your REPO MAN with 2 things changed, each taken from one of your songs: a pawned piano with keys that stick from your PAWNSHOP PSALM and a low dread hum from your THE PIT BOSS IS GONE. It is the man who still comes round to read the meter on houses that have had no power for a year. The REPO MAN machine party plays along: the train coupling on the kick, the old clock on the hat, the motor in its key, in the concrete hall on a worn tape. A is the new song, B your REPO MAN, C your SLOW BLEED, same loudness on a phone, over the real map, on the 120 beat. It is not in the game until you say yes. EYES AND EARS' line is owed (rule 119(c)); rule 158(d) put it here.
options: A, THE METER READER joins your night songs
